subject: variable background fill or rect in facet_grid

messages.author: 2ec9a7ffb866f600
messages.subject: variable background fill or rect in facet_grid
parts:
Hello,

 

Is it possible to vary the background fill or rect while using facet_grid? Borrowing from the ggplot2 guides,

p <- ggplot(diamonds, aes(carat, ..density..)) +  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.2)

p + facet_grid(cut ~ clarity)

 

For example, can the background fill or rect have different colors based on the peak density value, sort of in a heat map fashion?

 

Thank you,
James

messages.author: affa918ed63b6275
messages.subject: Re: variable background fill or rect in facet_grid
parts:
Hi

this may help you

ggplot(diamonds, aes(carat, ..density..)) + stat_bin(binwidth =
0.2,aes(colour=max(..density..)),geom="histogram") + facet_grid(cut ~
clarity)

in this case, the bars of histogram are filled.
you can draw background like this:

ggplot(diamonds, aes(carat, ..density..)) + facet_grid(cut ~
clarity)+stat_bin(binwidth = 0.2,aes(xmin=0, ymin=0
,xmax=5,ymax=3.3,fill=max(..density..)),geom="rect")+geom_histogram(binwidth
= 0.2)

this is, I think, a bad hack, and I like the first one.
